fusions.name: Whole Weight Arriving
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Bowled Over
fusions.desc: A charge that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, knocks them back 2 tiles and leaves them [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Wintered Hide
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 6 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while you carry it, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rolling Bulk
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
